summary: Backend-only retest of the group booking deposit policy normalization fix on the NestJS API (http://localhost:3001/api/v1). Created pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_group_room_mix_deposit.py (5 tests, all PASSED). Verified: (1) GET /properties/9d0680c0-.../operations/group-room-mix-suggestions?adults=2&children=0&arrivalDate=2026-08-16&departureDate=2026-08-17&preference=BEST_FIT now returns HTTP 200 for the NONE/0 property and every option's deposit is {policyType:'NONE', policyValue:0, required:false, suggestedAmount:0} (previously 400 VALIDATION_ERROR). (2) PATCH to PERCENTAGE 20 persists, suggestions stay 200 and deposit.suggestedAmount == round(20% of estimatedTotal) with required:true (e.g. 3920 -> 784); resetting to NONE returns 200 with suggestedAmount 0. (3) PATCH to FIXED_AMOUNT 5000 persists (GET reflects 5000) and suggestions return 200 with positive suggestedAmount (capped at estimated total, per Math.min logic). Invalid inputs still rejected: PERCENTAGE 150 -> 400, NONE with value 500 -> 400, FIXED_AMOUNT 0 -> 400. Fixture restored: DB row HILLSTON_IND is NONE / 0.00.

minor.issue: DTO rule GroupBookingDepositPolicyRule rejects {type:'NONE', value:0} with 400 ('value must be omitted when type is NONE'), while the service normalizer now treats an explicit 0 as valid. Inconsistent contract between write validation and read/normalize layers; a UI that always sends both fields will get a 400 when selecting NONE.

groupBookingDepositPolicyValue is serialized as null even though the DB column is NOT NULL and stores 0.00 for NONE. Suggestions endpoint returns 0 for the same field, so clients see two different representations.
Returns 201 Created for a login (non-resource-creating) action; 200 would be more conventional. Not a functional bug, only noted because tests must accept 201.

action_items: Optional: align update-property.dto.ts NONE rule with normalizeGroupBookingDepositPolicy so an explicit 0 is accepted (or make the UI omit the value field for NONE).
Optional: return 0 instead of null for groupBookingDepositPolicyValue on GET /properties/:id when type is NONE for consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: group-booking-deposit-policy.ts NONE branch is correct now, but PERCENTAGE/FIXED_AMOUNT rely on Number(...) coercion of persisted numeric strings; group-room-mix.service.ts passes Number(property.groupBookingDepositPolicyValue || 0), which would silently coerce a corrupt/NaN value to a 400 at read time. Consider normalizing at persistence time instead of on every read.
FIXED_AMOUNT deposit is capped by Math.min(value, total) so a 5000 fixed deposit on a 3920 total silently becomes 3920 - intended? Worth documenting.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Use http://localhost:3001/api/v1 (not 8001, not supervisor backend). Login returns HTTP 201 with token at data.accessToken. Run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_group_room_mix_deposit.py -v. The suite auto-resets the property deposit policy to NONE. Group room mix response shape: data.options[].deposit and data.options[].estimatedTotal / pricing.grandTotal.
rca_of_the_issue: Original 400 came from normalizeGroupBookingDepositPolicy rejecting any non-null value for NONE, including the persisted DB default 0 that group-room-mix.service.ts passes via Number(property.groupBookingDepositPolicyValue || 0). The fix accepts undefined/null/0 for NONE and only rejects >0; verified fixed end-to-end via the real endpoints.
